baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated noun from خ ل ق at words 1 and 6 places the creation of the heavens and earth and the creation of people under the single comparative أَكْبَرُ at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same act-category is applied to an upper/lower cosmic pair and to the human collective; the comparative ranks the magnitude of the former creative undertaking above the latter.

activation_trace.role: Origination supplies the common operation whose two objects are compared.
What is above and overshadows supplies the upper extent of the cosmic object.
The lower counterpart to the sky closes the cosmic span.
Greatness in magnitude provides the explicit ranking operator.
The visible human collective is both the lesser created object and the ignorant judging population.

changed_reading.before: One act of creation is simply said to be bigger than another.
changed_reading.after: A controlled same-root comparison makes the complete upper/lower created frame outweigh the human species as an object of origination.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two occurrences of خَلْق frame أَكْبَرُ, while أَكْثَرَ later introduces a second comparative axis: measured greatness versus numerical majority.
baseline_models.mechanism: The measuring branch of خ ل ق and magnitude branch of ك ب ر establish the relevant scale; ك ث ر then marks the many observers whose number does not confer knowledge of that scale.

activation_trace.role: Prior measuring and proportioning turn creation into an assessed order rather than an unexamined event.
Magnitude states the scale that the verse asks the reader to judge correctly.
Growth in number supplies the rival axis that is explicitly denied epistemic force.
Disclosure to a knower is the missing outcome despite the many human observers.

changed_reading.before: The verse contrasts a larger cosmos with smaller humans.
changed_reading.after: The verse corrects a scale judgment: measured creative magnitude is not indexed by the number of human observers, and a majority does not generate knowledge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The packet's split inventory for س م و includes a visible distinguishing mark, ن و س resolves to a human root with sensory apprehension, and ع ل م includes a guiding mark.
baseline_models.mechanism: The upper world can be carried as a marked, inferable field, while the humans equipped to perceive it fail to move from visible mark to disclosed knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Reading a visible sign as evidence supplies an exploratory semiotic layer to the heavens.
Seeing, hearing, or sensing gives the named human collective the capacity that the final negation frustrates.
A distinguishing mark that guides toward its object links perception to knowledge.

changed_reading.before: Most people lack an abstract fact about relative creative power.
changed_reading.after: Most perception-capable humans fail to read an already marked cosmic field into knowledge; the deficit is interpretive as well as informational.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ayah 56 locates self-exalting greatness inside disputants' chests and denies that they will attain its object; ayah 57 immediately relocates true greatness in the creation of the heavens and earth. The comparison therefore deflates a human claim to scale, not merely reports cosmic size.

activation_trace.role: Twisted contention identifies the speech-act whose hidden scale claim is exposed.
The chest as an origin of action localizes the motive that produces the disputation.
Self-exalting greatness supplies the false inner claimant to magnitude.
Arrival at a goal is negated, placing a ceiling on the disputants' pretension.
Objective magnitude in أَكْبَرُ supplies the corrective scale.
The overarching heavens give the corrective magnitude a cosmic object.

structural_cues: The same root ك ب ر moves from inner كِبْرٌ to the comparative أَكْبَرُ.
Negated attainment in 40:56 is followed by an explicit ranking in 40:57.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, the repeated root, inner pride, and failed attainment; I infer that 40:57 answers by relocating greatness. A live alternative is that 40:57 is only a general power comparison after the rebuke.

changed_reading.before: Cosmic creation is greater than human creation in the abstract.
changed_reading.after: The cosmic comparison punctures the disputant's chest-bound kibr: what is truly greater lies outside the self and exceeds the scale the self cannot attain.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ayah 59 repeats 'most people' but changes the failed predicate from knowing to believing in the coming Hour. The universal creator in 40:62 and the staged creation of people in 40:67 turn the greater-cosmos comparison into an a fortiori bridge from first creation to human return.

activation_trace.role: The repeated numerical majority binds the epistemic failure in 40:57 to the eschatological failure in 40:59.
The same human collective remains the subject across the predicate shift.
Heart-settling assent names the response that failed knowledge should have enabled.
Universal origination broadens the focus comparison into a statement of unrestricted creative agency.
Human origination begins the packet's staged account of the very lesser creation named in the focus.
The repeated focus noun supplies the greater-to-lesser premise for the inferred argument.

structural_cues: 40:59 repeats أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ only two ayat after 40:57.
40:62 names the creator of every thing, 40:67 sequences human formation, and 40:68 joins giving life, causing death, and effective decree.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated majority phrase, the Hour, universal creation, and human life stages; I supply the a fortiori arrow that the greater act warrants confidence in the lesser re-creation. The comparison can still be read more generally as a rebuke of ignorance.

changed_reading.before: The verse demonstrates divine power by comparing two creations.
changed_reading.after: The verse is a compressed resurrection warrant: failure to know the greater cosmic creation becomes, two ayat later, failure to trust the promised human return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following blind/seeing contrast, the later functional description of earth and sky, and the final question about denying shown signs make 'do not know' a failure of recognition in the presence of structured evidence rather than a mere data shortage.

activation_trace.role: Blindness of heart supplies the negative epistemic mode immediately after the focus.
Inner sight supplies the contrasting capacity needed to apprehend the comparison.
The lower counterpart from the focus is revisited as an arranged dwelling surface.
The upper counterpart from the focus is revisited as an overhead structure.
Construction by joining parts makes the sky's order inspectable rather than merely immense.
Visible signs name the evidence that is being shown and then challenged.
The opposite of recognition states the active failure toward those signs.
A mark that distinguishes and guides anchors the context's perceptual mechanism in the focus negation.

structural_cues: 40:58 immediately recasts the issue as blindness versus sight.
40:61 repeats the majority formula and changes the failed response to gratitude.
40:64 repeats earth and sky while assigning them stable functions; 40:81 closes with shown signs and denial.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies perceptual contrasts, repeated cosmic objects, displayed signs, denial, and failed gratitude; I infer a path from perception through recognition to thankful knowledge. The live alternative is morally neutral cognitive limitation.

changed_reading.before: Most people have not learned the proposition that cosmic creation is greater.
changed_reading.after: Most people fail to recognize a proposition materially displayed in the stable earth, built sky, and visible signs; ignorance has perceptual and responsive dimensions.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pharaoh orders a high human structure to reach the cords or routes of the heavens and inspect them; 40:56 later denies attainment to kibr, and 40:57 names cosmic creation as greater. With خ ل ق as measuring, the focus becomes a judgment on the failed attempt to make the heavens commensurable with a human project.

activation_trace.role: Joining parts into a construction supplies the human-made counterproject.
The high building gives that project its vertical scale.
Reaching a limit states the project's intended transition from human structure to cosmic access.
A cord or connection supplies the imagined means of access to the heavens.
The same overarching heavens later named in the focus are the target of the human project.
Inspection and attempted disclosure turn the construction into an epistemic instrument.
Self-exalting greatness links the failed reach back to the motive exposed immediately before the focus.
Measuring and proportioning anchor the context's human-versus-cosmic scale problem in the focus.
The focus comparative issues the final judgment on the two scales.

structural_cues: 40:36-37 combines human building, vertical reach, inspection, and the heavens.
The root س م و recurs in 40:37 and 40:57.
The tower's desired بلوغ is answered by negated بلوغ in 40:56 before the focus comparative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the tower, reach, cosmic target, inspection, later failed attainment, and comparative greatness; I infer that the tower is a human counter-measure exposed by 40:57. It may instead remain only an earlier narrative instance of arrogance.

changed_reading.before: The verse compares divine creation with the biological creation of humanity.
changed_reading.after: The verse also judges a human program of scaling and inspecting heaven: built reach cannot make the created cosmos commensurable with human pretension.

context_deltas.mechanism: Near the surah's end, earlier peoples are called more numerous, stronger, and richer in traces on earth, yet their gains do not suffice; they then exult in the knowledge they possess. This retrospectively specifies the focus error as confusing abundance, power, durable production, and possessed knowledge with adequate judgment of the greater creation.

activation_trace.role: Numerical predominance supplies the historical form of the majority's false warrant.
Strength gathered like rope strands adds concentrated capacity to numerical abundance.
Remaining marks on the earth supply visible evidence of human productive scale.
Failed sufficiency denies that accumulated works can secure their makers.
Exultant pride turns possession of knowledge into self-satisfaction.
Knowledge possessed by the people supplies the partial epistemic stock that they mistake for adequacy.
The focus majority anchors the terminal historical diagnosis.
The focus negation distinguishes adequate disclosure from merely having a body of knowledge.

structural_cues: 40:82 mirrors the focus's comparative syntax with أَكْثَرَ مِنْهُمْ and repeats earth.
40:82 joins number, strength, and material traces before denying their efficacy.
40:83 immediately names the knowledge in which those peoples exult.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored comparison, human traces, failed sufficiency, and proud possession of knowledge; I infer that 40:82-83 diagnoses the majority ignorance of 40:57. The live alternative is that the closing example warns historically without defining the earlier epistemic failure.

changed_reading.before: Most people simply lack knowledge of a cosmic fact.
changed_reading.after: The majority's ignorance is a scale error produced by human abundance: numbers, strength, works, and owned knowledge are treated as self-validating even though the larger created order exceeds them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the dust-cloud branch of ك ث ر as a material analogy rather than a lexical translation. It remains anchored in the focus's أَكْثَرَ, marked-sky and knowledge branches and is reinforced by blindness and the later numerical boast; downstream prose should label it an exploratory image.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَكْثَرَ at word 9 can carry the inventory image of dust that becomes abundant and rises, while the split س م و inventory and ع ل م both supply visible marks.

activation_trace.role: Rising abundant dust supplies an image for numerical mass obscuring rather than clarifying.
A visible distinguishing mark supplies what the obscuring majority fails to read.
A guiding mark makes obscuration an epistemic mechanism anchored in the final verb.
Dark cloud as a branch of blindness reinforces the material image of blocked apprehension.
Historical numerical predominance gives the focus image a social mechanism rather than leaving it decorative.

changed_reading.before: The majority is only a statistic describing how many people are ignorant.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, human multiplicity behaves like its own dust cloud: accumulated numbers obscure the cosmic marks whose scale should correct them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is form-distant because it combines the narrow-aperture split mapping of س م و with the human image in the pupil under ن و س. It remains packet-anchored and gains context from the immediate blind/seeing contrast, but downstream prose should present it only as an optical analogy about apparent scale, never as a translation of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet permits س م و to map to a narrow opening and ن و س to the human image seen in the eye, while أَكْبَرُ explicitly corrects scale.

activation_trace.role: A narrow aperture supplies the optical passage through which an immense object may appear compressed.
The human image in the pupil supplies a small visual representation that can dominate attention.
Objective magnitude corrects the scale suggested by the compressed visual representation.
Literal eyesight in the next ayah keeps the optical analogy connected to the local sequence.

changed_reading.before: The comparative reports objective size without addressing how humans perceive it.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the verse resists retinal scale: the vast heavens can arrive through a tiny aperture while the human image fills attention, so appearance must not govern the judgment of what is greater.

strongest_changes: The immediate كِبْرٌ/أَكْبَرُ sequence relocates greatness from disputants' chests to cosmic creation.
The repeated 'most people' formula in 40:59 and the creation sequence in 40:62-68 turn the comparison into an a fortiori resurrection warrant.
The mirrored abundance, strength, traces, and possessed knowledge in 40:82-83 diagnose majority ignorance as a false equation of human accumulation with epistemic adequacy.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made one comparative coordinate four mechanisms that a local reading could collapse: deflation of kibr, failed architectural commensuration, resurrection reasoning, and the inability of a numerous sign-seeing public to convert visible order into knowledge.
remaining_uncertainties: أَكْبَرُ may foreground magnitude, difficulty, rank, or burden in different retained models without selecting one.
خَلْقِ ٱلنَّاسِ may point primarily to first creation even though the Hour sequence activates re-creation.
The dust and optical models depend on form-distant branch mappings and require explicit exploratory qualification.
